nom: The Ordinary Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% High-Strength Exfoliating Serum for Uneven Texture

avis.texte: This is my favorite chemical exfoliant. I use it on my face about 1-2 times a week whenever I feel like it, and occasionally elsewhere on my body if needed. At that rate the small bottle still lasts me a few months which is nice. It dries down still slightly tacky, so I let it sit for about 30 minutes before rinsing off. That's been enough time for some to soak in and get to work. Getting up the next day my face always has less dry patches and does feel smoother over time as I use it. I have dry sensitive skin and have had no bad reactions over the years I've used it, but I try not to over do it either. I would imagine it would work just as well for other skin types.

I was gifted this product a couple of years ago and didn't really know much about it. But after using it for just a couple of weeks, I noticed a big difference in how my skin felt and looked. I have sensitive skin due to rosacea so I can't use a lot of products with powerful ingredients. This one is just the right mix. It helps slough dead skin cells from my face and makes my face feel smoother. The price point on this one is excellent. It's definitely a keeper in my daily skin care regiment.

I've been using this for the past week, cleared up my blackheads, pimples, and no dry skin. I apply it at night like it says to (but I do it without moisturizer) and my skin has become so clear! Definitely recommend.
I dont use this daily, but when I (40's) or my 15 year old daughter, have a pimple or dry skin patch, we use this and it works great! You only need a little drop and it does the trick!

I use after my shower 1-2 times a week followed by healing balm. It is definitely the best reaction my skin has had to a chemical exfoliant and slowly unclogging my pores! Glycolic kept disturbing my moister barrier and I break out w salicylic acid.

It's helping remove dead skin and dark marks I've had for years - I appreciate that its gentle and doesn't sting, I've even accidentally put it on a scratch that was slightly opened and it wasn't terrible stinging. Recommended for sensitive skin!

I've used this product for over 5 years. It gently exfoliates my skin. I use it 3 or 4 times a week and I can feel the difference in my skin texture when I go more than a week without using it. I'm in my mid 50s and and my skin feels much smoother and the finish of my makeup is much more natural looking when I'm using this. It's my favorite skincare product.

I love this product, I truly do - it clears my acne without drying my skin. honestly, since I started using it my skin started to look sooo good! BUT the smell....it smells like expired cucumber pickling water mixed with fermented milk.(the smell does go away when the solution dries out)
I really like this, I'm using in my nighttime routine before my mosturizer, I'll be using it for getting results 🤞

avis.titre: It's a start in my KP journey
avis.texte: I searched for the strongest product with Lactic acid since I have severe KP on my arms. I just needed something to smooth it out and get rid of that red swelled up look. I didnt use it as frequently but the times that I did, it did make a huge difference! The redness faded out and it is smoother than before. Not dire results that would have me shouting on teh rooftop for other KP havers. I will probably purchase it again to see how far it can go.

I don't write reviews a lot, but this product deserves one! I have keratosis pilaris and could never get a smooth shave because of it. I have been using this for TWO days and my legs are almost completely smooth! I am often pretty skeptical of cosmetic and skincare products that talk a big game of the effectiveness of their products especially at $100+ proce points, and sometimes even with positive reviews, but The Ordinary is humble, effective, and affordable. I'm a huge fan now. I bought several other skincare serums from them for facial skin concerns such as uneven texture, fine lines, enlarged pores and redness and I already see a difference there too after a week

PLEASE make this in a bigger bottle! I decided to try this for my KP (iykyk) and it has worked wonders compared to anything else I've tried! I paired this with the naturium lotion and my skin is practically almost cleared! I will say start slow especially if you have sensitive skin so you don't wreck your barrier!
Gave me the worst chemical burn right after putting it on had to wash it off immediately made my skin red and painful do not buy this

avis.titre: I'd compare this to Sunday Riley's lactic acid
avis.texte: I purchased this as a dupe to SR's Good Genes Lactic Acid and i honestly didnt expect it to work as well. I was pleasantly surprised that I noticed a huge texture difference within a few days' use. I'm prone to dry skin and this did not dry or irritate my skin at all. I havent got any new breakouts since using this. Im very happy with this product.

avis.titre: If you use Amlactin on your body, use this on your face
avis.texte: I've been using paula's choice BHA exfoliant for 2 years, with no noticeable results. But I've been using a lactic acid body lotion on my body and it keeps that skin clear. I bought this after it dawned on me that I should look into face lactic acid. This stuff has been reducing my break outs and helping clear existing acne. I'm using a vitamin c in addition to lighten scarring and I'm seeing a real improvement after a month of use. I'll be buying this forever. If you have success with lactic acid body lotion, you should buy this.
As an oily girl with textured skin this works pretty well. Be careful not to use more than one a day as it could irritate your skin. When this happens I just use a barrier cream than it's all good
I have tried several different brands of Lactic Acid 10%. I always come back to Ordinary projects.
I would definitely recommend this product. I have used it for 5 years.
PERFECT PERFECT!! I never write review but they deserve a good rating! My skin is so much brighter and those annoying little bumps on my face went away!

avis.titre: i have bought this like 10 times!
avis.texte: this is the only product i use other than face wash and moisturizer! it keeps my skin super clear and i use it every morinung and night!!

I heard Cleopatra liked using lactic acid so I decided to try this since the glycolic acid kept breaking me out too much. This lactic acid is awesome! I have what's either post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation or a pitted acne scar on my cheek (I can't tell but I have a medical history of PIH) and this is fixing it fast. Yeah, if it's PIH, it'd probably go away on its own, but this speeds up the process so much.
I always find myself repurchasing this product. It is not only wallet friendly but effective. It just works.
Combo skin here, even though I only used it 3x a week it broke me out after 2 weeks. I recommend people with combination skin not to use this as it will make your t zone really oily.

I love this product. I was introduced to lactic acid through a much pricier serum (Good Genes) and I couldn't justify the price. I tried this on a whim and it works better for me than a product that's literally 10x the price. The formula is not elegant. it's a very watery serum that doesn't have the greatest smell. More than once I've knocked the open bottle and lost a bit of product, but at least it's incredibly affordable! I have dry, mature, slightly sensitive skin. I can't use glycolic acid without irritation, and I've found lactic acid is a great option for me because it's hydrating in addition to exfoliating. I regularly get a fair bit of superficial dryness and this product clears up the flakiness literally overnight without further drying/dehydration or irritation. I use this 2-3x per week, alternating with the days I use tret.

I use adap. every night but thought maybe I should add some sort of peel to my routine. After a week of using this (in the morning because i use adap. at night) my face was so oily and I started breaking out. It says you can use every day so that's what I did but I realized doing that, it destroyed my skin barrier. So I healed my skin barrier and used this just once at night (and not use my adap. that night). And again, my face broke out and I had oily clogged pores. Took this out of my routine and now my face is normal and clear. Definitely not worth it. This is the third product by the ordinary I've used and haven't been particularly happy with any of their products

avis.titre: It does what it needs to
avis.texte: It exfoliates just as it says it does. My skin is smooth and more clear the next day.

I have sensitive skin, and this serum gives me the results I want without leaving my skin red, itchy, or irritated. I wash my face with a gentle cleanser, use a few drops of this all over, and then follow up with my night time moisturizer. This is great.

I've tried several lactic acids, and this is my least favorite. It didn't do anything. Thankfully it didn't actively harm my skin, but it's like I'm putting nothing on. This is my second ordinary product I've tried that doesn't do anything to my skin. Don't waste your money.
I love this product, in the morning after use my skin glows! I like to use it once a week and dont pair it with a retinol.

avis.titre: First product that FIXED my dry skin!
avis.texte: I doscovered this product at 28 after having dry skin my whole life. Now my skin glows without being oily. My laugh lines, "11" lines, and forehead lines have dramatically decreased in appearance. The light exfoliation property has eliminated the dry skin that caused those very defined lines in the past. I have now been buying this religiously. I get compliments on my smooth complexion and I always give the credit to this product. The bottle lasts a long time too!

I don't know what exactly it was, bc I've never had sensitivity before to lactic acid, but this gave me horrible contact dermatitis. My face is covered in bumps, it's extremely dry, red, itchy, and burns. The only thing that is helping right now is Aquaphor and Bag Balm. I can't even put sunscreen on

avis.titre: I do buy this product over and over.
avis.texte: I have combination skin, and this acid helps to keep my pores clean and clear.

I have a rough and bumpy dark patch on the lower left side of my chin. I applied this lactic acid to the patch nightly and slowly but surely it lightened, smoothed, and has all but disappeared. I have a dry patch on one of my elbows that I've started to apply it to at night and it has removed the dry patch there as well. Very happy with the results.

I bought this Lactic acid but am a bit confused. It says: 'Use once a day ideally in PM' (but doesnt say for how long). I assumed the above meant leave on overnight but then it also says 'contact of the product must be for limited duration or frequency' which suggests a quick duration i.e. 15 minutes and wash off as id say overnight was not limited duration ? Reviews say leave on. Google says dont leave lactic acid on skin for longer than 15 minutes. My brain is boggled - help ..
Not bad, it's way better for acne than the hyaluronic acid and doesn't make me break out more or ruin my skin barrier.

I bought this almost a year ago and I still find myself going to the internet to try and understand it. PLEASE put more instructions on your packaging. Also, how does everyone avoid ripping off their fingerprints when applying?

avis.titre: The only thing that clears out sebaceous filaments
avis.texte: I have been using this product nightly for 4 months. First of all, I've hardly made a dent in the bottle. You get a lot of good product for a very reasonable price. Secondly, your skin will purge at first and get a little irritated and red (I have sensitive skin). However, with continued use: your fines lines are less visible, your pores are absolutely cleared OUT - no dark spots even with sebaceous filaments, your skin GLOWS. I cleanse nightly with an oil cleanser (oil dissolves oil), then a clay or salicylic acid cleanser to reduce pore size. I then apply this product under a good moisturizer. It is very watery, so be careful where you apply because it runs. Rub it in really well for best results, really get it in there before you apply moisturizer. I am very impressed, and I spent 1/10th of what I expected to see these results. Switched almost completely to this brand, have not had a bad experience with any product.

avis.titre: How have I gone so long without this?
avis.texte: The only exfoliator I've ever used is retinol and I was liking it but it wasn't giving me the exact results I needed anymore. I got this and within one use I noticed a difference. My skin is a lot smoother and my closed comedones have shrunk and are on their way out. This is an acid so don't use it with other acids or retinol because it could be too harsh for your skin. I had no problems with using it full strength right away. I only apply at night and use SPF in the morning.

avis.titre: Love this serum for gentle exfoliation on sensitive skin
avis.texte: This product is a lifesaver for my sensitive reactive mature skin. I use this and then put a light gel mositurizer over it every evening. I have seen a great difference in my skin overall. Seems like it works well on hrominal acne. I have been using this for about 4 months now and no reactions…I will use this forever!
I've only been using it for 2 weeks, but I think it's working pretty well. It's definitely diminishing the bumps I get all over my forehead. Will keep using.

avis.titre: Skin Is Smoother. Dark Spots Have Lightened.
avis.texte: I'm in the beauty industry, and have discovered this line. Very impressed, and offers nice results without the high price tag. Highly recommend! 💖
Literally the best lactic serum I have used in my 6 years of skincare. We need a 120ml because the 30ml only lasts about a week or 2 of usage.

avis.titre: I would buy this item again and again
avis.texte: This product was given to me as a gift a year ago and am obsessed..I can't live without!

avis.titre: Has become a staple in my skin care routine
avis.texte: Extoliates gently and works immediately! Now a staple in my weekly skincare routine. Eats away dead skin snd gunk immediately and helps to keep my skin clear. I struggle with hormonal acne and acne likely caused/worsened from my makeup and The Ordinary's chemical exfoliators are always a godsend. Lactic acid is gentler than the AHA/BHA one and can be used more times during a week which is gentler snd helps keep my skin clear. Love it! And will never fo without it!
I rub it on my face and neck and leave it on for an hour then I wipe it off with a damp cloth then I put on serum and moisturizer
it kinda works but I don't really see much of a difference, it js stings
ive only been using this for a few weeks, but its really helped my skin and got rid of a lot of texture!

Simple formulation that does a nice job exfoliating while and plumping up the skin. I use this maybe once a twice a week, a small drop at night time only, after cleanse and a hydrating serum, topping with a light moisturiser in winter months. I find my skin smoother and firmer in the morning after using this. Of course, it's important not to exaggerate (not to use too much or too frequently), and to follow with barrier repairing skincare and sun protection.
I have purchased this product multiple times. It works overnight to give you smooth, hydrated, and glowy skin in by the morning.

avis.titre: Good product at good price point!
avis.texte: Ive used this product for a week now and am happy with the results. It is way less irritating that AHA/BHA on my skin.
I started using this a year or so ago and now I can't go without it! It helps to keep my skin feeling smooth and healthy!

It kinda burns when putting on and Ig bc it's an acid and stuff but yeah idk. I dont use it rlly often it said it helps with texture a little but I haven't seen any difference tbh. I mean at least its not expensive?

The first night I wore this I was amazed in the morning. My skin is aging and doesn't bounced back like it used to. I will be using this every evening. My son is 15 and even notices results in the morning.
Totally clears up the KP on my cheeks. So glad a salesperson at Ulta recommended it!

I have been using the Lactic Acid 10% +HA for around a month now and my skin feels so hydrated and smooth. I actually noticed the difference the first time I used it. Little bumps on my forhead dissapeared in a week and my skin was really smooth. I use this under a mosturiser at night and my skin feels very hydrated.

I bought this about a month ago and hoped it would work…. It has! It's surpassed all of my expectations! Background: I have KP (keratosis pilaris) and I have tried everything on the market to get rid of a few problem areas on my arms and around my knees. None of the expensive creams, soaps, exfoliators, or scrubs have worked. I've even tried home remedies! I applied a dropper full to each area that was bumpy & rough after each shower for 3 weeks and the bumps are gone!!!! I'm going to keep this on hand forever! Thank you The Ordinary! I have the smoothest skin I've ever had in my entire life! Love!
I have dry, sensitive skin & this serum burns like crazy. I've tried it off & on for a couple of months, but am just going to give it away & let someone else see if it works for them.

Ordinary has a ton of great products that are super affordable and you get quite a bit of product. I apply this lactic acid at night after cleansing my face, it absorbs quickly. After about 5 mins when it's fully absorbed I'll apply a heavy nighttime moisturizer. Within 3 weeks my skin was appearing brighter, smoother and glowy. I alternate this in my night time routine with retinol. One day lactic, next day retinol.

avis.titre: Is this a wash off treatment or a leave-on?
avis.texte: I don't have a review yet, as I just purchased a bottle of the Lactic Acid exfoliating serum today. I'm a bit confused as to how this should be used. Is this a treatment that you leave on for a few minutes (or 10, 15 minutes?) and then wash off? Or, do you apply it after cleansing and leave it on?

I was very excited to get this product and did plenty of research on how to apply it properly, however it started breaking me out within only two weeks of usage. I have relatively dry skin and when I started using the product, I had one or two small bumps on my forehead that I had plans on clearing up. However, after using this product at night, I had multiple red bumps popping up on my forehead and cheeks. I'm too afraid to use it now, and I'm very disappointed.

I used this product hoping to exfoliate and brighten skin. Before, I only had a few blackheads on my nose, but this caused break outs which I never had before. After almost 2 months, I finally stopped using it. Caused a slight burning sensation as well. I am still struggling to get rid of the continous break outs is caused…

avis.titre: Too strong acids in the product caused more acne
avis.texte: It's said to apply daily which I did (in the PM) and my skin got terrible - 2 times more breakouts and red colour of the skin. I stopped using after 2 weeks. Waste of money.

I started using this product on the night of 7th June, it is a month now. My skin smoothened out in two weeks, it's brighter and clearer. I used it every night as instructed on the bottle. At first, my skin could get very dry but I am now okay. I combine it with niacinamide twice a day as well.
The product worked okay, really have seen no difference though.

My skin type is oily for the most part, but I still get a bit of skin that needs sloughed off. This product acts as a gentle exfoliant on dry, dead skin. And I love that no micro beads or gritty scrub are required - this makes exfoliating your face so easy! I use this serum once or twice a week, and I always notice a difference in the smoothness of my skin and overall tone & radiance. I'd highly recommend this serum!
This product does more for my acne than my prescription face cream does, 10/10!!
Leave my skin glowy and bright mkrning after use. Great product for hydration and tightening pores.

i am a going to buy this but is it okay if i use a CERAVE SA smoothing cleanser and then use this serum or do i have to buy the ordinary cleanser as well as the serum?? i just need to ensure that using a CERAVE cleanser and a whole different company's serum wont lead to me breaking out.

avis.titre: Thought I May Have Needed Some Exfoliation
avis.texte: I received this item last week after thinking that my always dry skin needed some help with exfoliation. I have been using tretinoin products for the last 5 or so years but always had some additional flaking around my mouth and chin area. I have used this 10% lactic acid wice this week instead of the tretinoin and my skin has already exfoliated to the point where I cannot see the skin flaking. I am ecstatic! I am going to use the 10% lactic acid one night, then the tretinoin the night after, and keep on with this until I can use the lactic acid daily. When that happens, I will buy the next exfoliating serum up and go from there. You would think that the tretinoin would have taken care of my skin and had done the exfoliating. Gamechanger with adding AHA's forsure!

I've used this for a few months not knowing it was a peeling formula. The directions are not clear whatsoever, I'm assuming it's a leave-on product but it says limit duration and frequency of use but also says use once per day… confusing. Since it's meant to be an exfoliator, it has no way to explain how to remove dead skin cells (I've been using it as a normal serum and my skin rubs off when I apply other serums). For future will be applying, waiting a few minutes and rubbing skin off, then rinsing before applying other serums. And won't be doing it daily… recommendations are appreciated.

i loved this BUT only thing about it is that sometimes it felt like my skin would burn and that's why i give it 4 stars but other than that i have noticed a difference in my skin when i was using this !!!
Use it every evening after using the toner and my skin-care night routine. Perfect match. skin look good even and clear.
sadly I wanted it to work but I tried it and gave me cystic pimples :/ I feel like maybe it doesn't work for oily skin

I really love this stuff I use it at night when I'm having a break out or heat rash then in the morning my skin is smooth. I use it 1-2 a week. When I first got it I used it everyday for 4 days and my skin was purging so I gave my skin a break and use it once to twice a week.

I really love this stuff I use it at night when I'm having a break out or heat rash then in the morning my skin is smooth. I use it 1-2 a week. When I first got it I used it everyday for 4 days and my skin was purging so I gave my skin a break and use it once to twice a week.

avis.titre: Got a bad bottle /batch maybe a return not happy
avis.texte: Broke me out - I NEVER get pimples I had like 20 gave me dark spots looked further into it and my bottle isn't the right color !! Was like pee yellow cant find a place to add photo wish I would have read what color it should be before I applied it to my face .:( worked on My skin for so long just to ruin it will this lactic acid in one day

1."Contact of the product with the skin must be of limited frequency or duration. " please elaborate what do you mean by that because at the same time you say that you should not rinse off this product. 2. How many times per week it can be used?

I've been using this most nights for a little over a month and I've noticed that my skin appears smoother, brighter, and clearer (I'm prone to clogged pores on my nose). I'm very happy with the results so far. I haven't had any issues with sensitivity.

I have very dry skin so my skin often has some roughness and dullness. The first time I used this I saw results! My skin looks and feels so smooth! I was nervous about using 10% instead of 5% but the store I went to only had the 10% and it was fine! I'm only using it 1 or 2 times per week just to be safe but I'm still seeing great results.

avis.titre: New serum for P. M routine!
avis.texte: this is a great exfoliating serum that has really helped with my texter and skin tone/ discoloration. Now I only use this in the P. M. and I rotate this with The Amino acid +B5 and three Nicinimide + zinc so like every other evening. Also for me, 3-4 drops max on skin thats been triple cleansed prior. then add no more then 3 drops of my other water based serums followed by the ordinarys cold pressed rose oil . my skin has never been better even at 41! I've got combo/dry leaning skin. Now if your skin is super sensitive or you you have some fresh break outs .. becareful!! this might not be the one, cause it can cause bad irritation if it gets on already inflamed or broken skin!!
In the more serious parts of my face that struggle with acne I've definitely noticed a difference in the size of the pimples and texture of my face- it's starting to look smoother as the weeks go on!

I have oily acne-prone skin. I've been using this at night as the second-to-last part of my skincare routine for years. I've personally noticed a huge difference in my uneven skin tone and texture. Love it!

After reading reviews about how brilliant this product is for acne, I originally tried the 5% (used this daily for around 3 weeks) and then introduced the 10% (which I'll use every 2/3 days in the PM) my skin has been drastically better, with almost instant results. I was having hormonal acne, which has reduced by around 75% - I feel so much more confident! After applying this, I wait for it to dry and use Azeliac Acid in my t zone and chin, followed by a moisturiser. GAME. CHANGER! - skin care has been trial and error for me, and its taken 6 months to work this routine out.

I ordered this because I read reviews about it and like the review below mine, mine also does not look as pictured? Different color serum? I've been staring at it for 5 minutes wondering if shipping affected this or if I was sent a bad batch?

avis.titre: I have purchased these products since they came out!
avis.texte: I love ALL Ordinary products. They work and sell at a decent price point.

I've always had flaky dry skin, especially in the winter. So much so that any foundation or even Bebe cream or tinted moisturizer would look gross. I use this stuff every night and it keeps my skin flake free. I don't have to use harsh scrubs anymore! I have very sensitive skin too.

Please.tell me.you didn't change the formula? I have used this product for years along with Vitamin C serum, and the last 2 bottles I recently purchased were significantly lighter in color (not the usual amber/light brown color). The text felt different as well. I'm not sure if I got 2 bad batches, but if this is the new formula, it seems watered down, is not as effective and I don't like it at all. Please keep original formula or change back. Do not like the changes at all. Was OOS for months and now a different color, texture with no updated information?? Unacceptable. Would not recommend if this is a new formula and not simply a one-off. Love original formula.
The product is good but the instructions are unclear. How much should I use? How often should I use this? Do I use it after or before moisturising?
I have been using this nightly for about a month now. My skin's texture and tone are so much more even and bright. I use this in conjunction with the marine hyaluronic serum.

avis.titre: Burned the entire area around my eyes.
avis.texte: This product burned the skin around my entire eye area. The area is red, dry, wrinkled, and extremely painful. I've used other acids, including tca, with no issues in the past.
I been using this product since last year, can't live without it.

My skin has never been the same since I used this product￼. It is go to￼. It clears up acne as well as giving your skin even tone. I've tried a lot of The Ordinary products and this is by far the best one￼.

Ii have suffered from acne all my life, and everywhere. Face, back, chest. It has ruined my self esteem and all that, tried everything from every level and all that. Like many who buy different products from newer brands with hope that this time something will work. Well I got an allergic reaction to something right when my skin had cleared up thanks to the overwhelming difference their HA was making on my face. And I ended up with not even pimples but welts on my face and back. It has been horrifying. I had just received this product in the mail and started to use. It is crazy how this thing is attacking the welts and dark spots. Within a few days despite those days being the days I work which usually worsens my skin conditions, my skin went back down to smooth. It is now attacking the scars left (I did try picking at these). Some skin around my mouth is peeling a little because I think I let too much out a few times. Then again the places it is peeling are the areas that are darker from the rest of my skin. It really saved me from weeks, maybe months of mental anguish, because in the past when this happens I then break out with regular pimples on top of that. I saw this starting up on my chin but continued to use this with the HA and spot treated the chin ones with an overnight mask and they have almost entirely gone back down. Only one bump appears still active. Impressive for just one night. I hope this continues to help me on my journey to just regular, clear, smooth ski

I was afraid that adding this acid to my skincare routine would cause irritation. I've had none. I use it everyday in the morning after a vitamin c serum. Only thing I would change is the consistency. It's a bit watery and therefore somewhat difficult to apply. Will continue to use.

I have been using the 10% Lactic Acid for 6 months now and it has changed the quality/appearance of my skin dramatically. My face is no longer red and blotchy, is nice and smooth and has a much more even texture! It looks beautiful!
Absolutely love it! It is a bit strong for sensitive skin, but exfoliates and hydrates the skin just perfectly.

I use this along with glycolic acid, (my skin handle it very well), and the result after used them every night for a year is just wow!! Im 46 and have no wrinkles now. I did not have alot before I startet, but my skin was a bit dull and I had some rosacea and scars after acne. The skin around my eyes was way more puffy than now. And now the rosacea is almost gone and my scars hardly show. My skin is glowing, it feels smooth and firm. I also use granactive retioind 5% and hyaluronic acid serum from The Ordinary. (and spf 50 all year round). I REALLY REALLY LOVE your products :D

I bought this about two months ago, and Ive had terrific results, my skin didn't even break out when i started to use this, and it started aiding my bad acne spots! Just be sure to read the acids you can't use with this!!
Used it for my mom as she has a dark neck area due to health reasons. Cleared her up after a week or so. Put a couple drops on a cotton exfoliating pad after showers and saw a difference fast.

avis.titre: Gentle and effective! Great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have been using this for over a year now and it is great! I have very reactive / sensitive skin and a lot of skin care products break me out. Not this one. Excellent gentle exfoliant. I use 4 drops at night, 2x a week. Wake up with glowing skin.
I like it! Sometimes it burns a bit, I only use a small amount of night maybe like 3 nights. But it's really good I do see a difference

I have always been very low maintenance with my skincare routine but after turning 38 it finally caught up with me. My girlfriend bought a handful of product from the ordinary and now I absolutely cannot live without this 10% lactic acid serum. It is so effective, almost like instant Botox on my forehead and it really smooths out and plumps my jowl lines. I will say my skin is very sun damaged and not at all sensitive so it may not be for everyone but for someone who really needs something strong, I absolutely love the lift and glow it gives me. I'm hooked.

I have had acne prone skin (also sensitive and dry from prescription creams) for 15 years now, so I am starting off slow with this product and only using it once a week and I'll build up to maybe twice a week. The evening I used this I didn't apply my prescription acne medicine because I thought it may be too harsh. The next morning I woke up to a smoother looking complexion (not as porous and scarred from acne). My skin also felt smoother, and my makeup applied nicely and didn't look as patchy as it usually it is.

I use this maybe twice a week. I have combination/bumpy skin & this has really made my skin clearer & smooth. Doesn't tingle or burn

After not taking the best care of my skin for a couple of years I decided I should get it together. This product was the only addition to my routine and it alone has TRANSFORMED my skin back to being smooth, soft, and with a glow. Highly recommend. I started using this product a few days a week in combination with my moisturizer to help mitigate any burning sensation. Now I use it daily without any issues. After a week of daily use, the results were dramatic.

I use this one night a week skipping my other potent skincare products that night. A few nights later, while using a cleansing balm, the dead skin cells just roll off . The next day my foundation applies perfectly.
I love this serum. It's a tad bit watery but it's effective. The price is good too. It keeps my skin smooth and it's not harsh at all.
Good skin texture revival tool. Helped to resurface my untextured skin and is a good skincare tool to have on hand!

Bought this a while ago when I had a lot of active breakouts and delayed using until they started to clear. Used this only a few times and have already seen a difference -- used in the shower before a gentle cleanser, figured I'd rinse off until my skin builds tolerance as went straight for the 10% serum. My face has been purging slightly but so far with no irritation which is good, just tiny tiny whiteheads. After a 10hr waitressing shift in a heatwave I really needed an exfoliation, this has worked perfectly! My face feels so smooth and decongested, I have noticed my pores also look way smaller and general texture has improved as well (even for acne scarring). I've had dry-sensitive skin all my life but recently have been more towards combination, this has done a great job of evening that out without leaving my face feeling stripped and irritated. I have been using Niacinimide + Zn as my main serum so excited to see how the two mix when I'm able to not rise this off. Says to avoid using on broken skin like many other TO products, but I haven't (yet) experienced any ill effects of this other than stinging on application. Would definitely recommend, especially to those starting out in skincare or looking for more clinical products.

I'm black with a skin color that would be considered medium brown. I attribute my dark marks fading away to this product. I've been using it on and off since mid April. I won't act as if the marks are all gone, but it's significantly better than what it used to be. My skin has been pretty terrible since February of 2020 and the marks seemed to never go away until I started using this. I'm hoping my skin will be pretty spotless in 2-3 more months. I wanted to start with the 5%, but that one is only sold online. So I opted for this one. One of the workers (pale skinned) told me to be careful with it because it burned her face to the point she couldn't even touch it, but I've been fine. I mixed it with the Alpha Arbutin to lessen the strength some. Once my skin started getting used to it, I started applying it first. I went through periods of using it every day and then stopping for a couple weeks. I can't apply it every day or else my skin on the problem areas will start to look tired and worn out. I've been opting for using it a couple times a week and it's been good. I did purge some, but nothing terrible.
cleared up my closed comedones on my cheeks within a week! never had such clear skin
I apply this everyday, before sunscreen and makeup. It has improved the texture of my skin. Affordable too.

I have always had fairly clear skin, but used to get occasional big blemishes and little bumps. When I started using this product my skin became soft as ever and I swear I haven't had a big breakout in 2 years now. Amazing for mask-ne too during pandemic.

avis.titre: Did not expect it to work so fast!
avis.texte: SKIN TYPE: Combo/oily, acne prone. I use this whenever I start to see texture on my skin and holy cow does this work FAST! I dilute this with hyaluronic acid at night time. I kid you not, I notice a HUGE difference the next morning. I love this stuff, if you're on the fence about this, trust me just try it out! WARNING: does burn a little, hence dilution.
